type get_mol_mr = (_: {
// SMILES string of the molecule.
smiles: string

type get_ring_count = (_: {

smiles: string

// SMILES string of the molecule.
smiles: string

// SMILES string of the molecule.
smiles: string

type get_qed = (_: {
// SMILES string of the molecule.
smiles: string

// SMILES string of the molecule.
smiles: string

// SMILES string of the molecule.

}) => any;

type get_labute_asa = (_: {

}) => any;

type get_kappa3 = (_: {

smiles: string
}) => any;

smiles: string
}) => any;

// Return unspecified stereocenter count.
type get_num_unspecified_atom_stereo_centers = (_: {

smiles: string
}) => any;
